protocol: One process per frozen backend, same 16MiB recovered input and20 alternating nearby edits, retain8. First edit reported separately. Fresh-parse validation disabled for this timing control; full single-edit and corpus equivalence were checked separately. No concurrent builds/tests. This is a regression investigation, not a new first-edit p95 admission.
